Commentary.Commentary: That wraps up the formalities for this series. New Zealand have regained the Chappell-Hadlee Trophy by winning it 2-0. The Kiwis will now next host the South Africans, which begins on the 17th of February with the T20I. While, the Aussies now head back to their country to host the Sri Lankans for a 3-match T20I series which begins on the same day. Until then, it's goodbye from us.

TRENT BOULT is awarded the MAN OF THE MATCH for his exceptional performance with the ball as he kept troubling the Australian batsmen throughout. He also finished with his career best figures of 10-1-33-6!

Earlier in the day, the Black Caps would have been disappointed with the way they ended with the bat after such a positive start. Taylor did all the talking with the bat with the help of some support from Brownlie who came into the side after a lay off of two years. Faulkner was the pick of the bowlers for Australia as he picked important wickets to stop the run flow. It was a good game of cricket with even contest between the bat and the ball. The visitors will be gutted as it's their seventh loss in a row away from home.

Australia had a rocky beginning as both the openers were struggling out there in the middle. Finch and Head got starts but could not capitalise on it. Stoinis also tried his best but was countered by spin. Starc and Cummins kept them in the game but there was Boult who had different plans altogether. He kept on rattling through the defences as he finished with his career best figures of 10-1-33-6. Santner also bowled well with the skipper chipping in with the crucial wicket of Finch.

NZ WIN THE CHAPPELL-HADLEE SERIES 2-0! Another enthralling game of cricket which kept shifting momentum. It was never too certain which team would have the last laugh. There is one player who stood out in between both the teams and that was the World's No.1 ODI bowler - Trent Boult! Take a bow! We were lucky to witness one of the best bowling performances.
OUT b Trent Boult. Australia have been bowled out.
OUT c Ross Taylor b Trent Boult. Australia have lost their ninth wicket.

UPDATE AT 45 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 250/8 - This game is looking like a swing. It's swinging the other way every other ball. Starc and Cummins were chasing the target really well till Boult again came to the rescue of the hosts. With only an over left for Boult, it will be interesting to see who has the last laugh. Will Starc guide his team to victory or will Boult ruin his party?
OUT c Mitchell Santner b Trent Boult. Australia have lost their eighth wicket.

UPDATE AT 40 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 199/7 - Has Australia lost the plot here? Santner has landed the wicket of Stoinis who is out for 42(48). So with Cummins and Starc in the middle, it would take something special from these two to chase this total down with only a couple of wickets left. New Zealand will be happy to see the wickets falling as they are closing in on a series win.
OUT c Jimmy Neesham b Mitchell Santner. Australia have lost their seventh wicket.

UPDATE AT 35 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 177/6 - Williamson's bowling change has worked! Twin strikes by the World no.1 bowler Trent Boult has again swung the momentum of the game. With 6 wickets down, Stoinis is the last of the recognized batsman left. He nearly did it in the last match. Can he do it here again?
OUT c Ross Taylor b Trent Boult. Australia have lost their sixth wicket.
OUT c Dean Brownlie b Trent Boult. Australia have lost their fifth wicket.

UPDATE AT 30 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 159/4 - Stoinis seems to have carried his rich form from the last match as he looks to settle in. He got a lucky boundary before but is punishing all the bad balls. The visitors will want Head and Stoinis to stay till the end and guide their team to a win. The hosts want another wicket soon to put the visitors on the back foot.

UPDATE AT 26 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 127/4 - Just when Finch looked settled in the middle, the Kiwi skipper managed to outsmart him. Williamson is slipping in his overs quickly which is mounting some pressure on the Australian team. Maxwell managed to bag a silver duck which has brought out the main in-form Stoinis at the crease. Can Head and Stoinis guide their team home?
OUT c Tom Latham b Mitchell Santner. Australia have lost their fourth wicket.
OUT c Trent Boult b Kane Williamson. Australia have lost their third wicket.

UPDATE AT 20 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 110/2 - The Australian skipper is leading the chase from the front as he has reached his fifty and surely looks hungry for many more. Williamson tried getting himself into the act but he could not turn out to be effective. The only person who could be blamed for this is only himself as he dropped his opposite skipper. Which skipper will have the last laugh?

UPDATE AT 15 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 80/2 - Aussies have managed to negotiate this phase well as they are back to scoring at a brisk pace without playing any risky shots. Finch looks like the guy who has settled in. Maybe I jinxed Boult getting off the attack, the hosts will be wanting a wicket from somewhere quickly as the Aussie skipper is looking dangerous every passing ball.

UPDATE AT 10 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 52/2 - Twin strikes in Boult's over has brought the Kiwis back into the game. Shaun Marsh's struggle out there ended with a run out while Handscomb went back into the dressing room for a silver duck. Finch is fighting from the other end as Head has joined him in the middle. Boult is making life difficult for the batsmen but how long will he keep bowling?
OUT b Trent Boult. Australia have lost their second wicket.
OUT run out (Mitchell Santner). Australia have lost their first wicket.

UPDATE AT 5 OVERS, TARGET - 282,  AUS 22/0 - Aussies have managed to survive the new-ball for now. Finch gave a tough chance to Southee who could not hold onto it off his very own bowling. He and Boult, both are bowling really well but are unable to draw first blood. Marsh seems to be struggling out in the middle though. Due to lack of television feed, there won't be ball-by-ball commentary for this match but we shall keep you posted with updates frequently.
